Author: Rajesh Bindal
Bench: Rajesh Bindal
 1
 In The Supreme Court Of India
 Criminal Appellate Jurisdiction
 Criminal Appeal Nos.2551 - 2552/2025
 [@ Slp [Crl.] Nos.3276-3277/2024]
 Ramnath Kewat @ Bhursoo Appellant(s)
 Versus
 State Of Madhya Pradesh Respondent(s)
 O R D E R
Leave granted.
The notice in this appeal was issued only with respect to the consideration of reducing the sentence imposed upon the appellant.

The appellant was concurrently convicted for the offences punishable under Sections 376(2)(i), 302 and 201 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and Sections 5 and 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The High Court vide the impugned judgment has modified the death penalty imposed upon the appellant by the trial court, to one where the appellant was sentenced to undergo a period of 35 years(without remission).

Accordingly, after the appellant preferred the present appeal before us, we called for an affidavit from the respondent-State so as to consider the case Reason: of the appellant for reduction of sentence.
The compliance affidavit filed by the respondent-State indicates that the conduct of the appellant in prison has been satisfactory.

Taking note of the above and the fact that at the time of the occurrence, the appellant was 28 years of age, we are inclined to modify the sentence imposed upon the appellant from 35 years without remission to 27 years without remission.
Ordered accordingly.
The appeals are allowed, in part.
Pending application(s), if any, shall stand disposed of.

...................J. [M.M. SUNDRESH] ...................J. [RAJESH BINDAL] NEW DELHI;
